stages.name: Plan
stages.does: Turns the ask into searches, hashtags and a keep/drop rule (what to look for, and what to keep).

output.NAME: husband-skit-scroll
output.TITLE: Wife's scroll: husband skits and holiday chaos
output.WHOSE_SCROLL: A woman in her 30s-50s who laughs at marriage skits and couples humor, and who scrolls family holiday chaos while hunting for what to get her husband.
output.KEEP_RULE: A skit, meme, reaction or chaos clip about husbands, marriage, couples or family holidays that is funny enough to send to a friend or her husband.
output.DROP_RULE: Gift guides, 'what I got my husband' hauls, product recommendations, marriage advice, relationship coaching, brand accounts, and anything teaching or selling.

stages.name: Pull
stages.does: Runs every search on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube; turns away ads, old posts and small posts at the door.

stages.name: Sift
stages.does: Sorts every new post into a lane: entertainment, educational, selling or junk. Only the first two stay.
